standard_prerequisites.name: G-flows, ambits, suprema and factors
standard_prerequisites.statement: An ambit is a flow with a distinguished point whose orbit is dense, the class of ambits of a class of flows is its closure under these maps, suprema and factors are the two operations of the category of flows, and a closed left-invariant unital star-subalgebra of the bounded right-uniformly continuous functions carries the flow of the group on its spectrum, whose ambits are the factors of that flow. The author's own definitions are the ones used by the counted statement and proof.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted proposition is the construction of the algebra attached to a class of flows, and it states that the class of flows closed under suprema and factors is recovered from the algebra as the family of factors of one canonical flow.

core_obligations: Construct the canonical flow: take the supremum of the flows given by the closure of the orbit of each function in the algebra, which is an ambit of the class because the class is closed under suprema (source line 462).

Identify the algebra of the canonical flow: the functions on the spectrum attached to the distinguished point form a unital left-invariant closed star-subalgebra of the bounded right-uniformly continuous functions, so it only remains to show that it equals the algebra of the statement (source line 462).
Reduce membership to a containment of flows: a function belongs to that algebra exactly when the ambient generated by it is a subflow of the canonical flow (source line 462).

Transfer to Gelfand compactifications: by the Gelfand correspondence for these algebras, that containment is equivalent to the ambient of the function being a factor of the canonical flow, which is the article's proposition on Gelfand algebras (source line 462).

Close both directions: the direct implication uses that the class is closed under factors, and the converse uses that the ambient of any function of the algebra appears among the flows whose supremum is the canonical flow (source line 462).

proof_roadmap.step: Build the canonical flow as the supremum of the ambits of the functions in the algebra, which is an ambit of the class by closure under suprema.
Show it suffices to prove that the algebra of the spectrum equals the algebra of the statement, and rewrite membership in it as containment of the corresponding ambient.
Pass to Gelfand compactifications to turn that containment into being a factor, then close the equivalence using closure under factors and the definition of the supremum.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 doi:10.5802/ahl.16 的 Proposition prop:KA（源 457-459 行，证明 461-463 行）：设 G 是拓扑群、X 是一类 G-流且其 X-G-ambit 类对**上确界与因子封闭**，则 A={f∈RUCB(G): G↷cl(G·f)∈X} 是 RUCB(G) 的单位、左不变、闭 C*-子代数，且流 G↷(G^A,e_G) 的因子恰是 X-G-ambit。证明不是例行核验：先取 **X-ambit 的上确界** (X,x)=∨_{f∈A} cl(G·f)（由上确界封闭性它仍在类内），把问题归约为「谱上的代数 C(X)_x 是否等于 A」；再把 f∈C(X)_x 改写成子流包含 ⟨f⟩⊂C(X)_x，经 **Gelfand 紧化**（引同章命题 prop:Gelfand）翻成「cl(G·f) 是 (X,x) 的因子」，最后用**因子封闭性**（正方向）与**上确界的定义**（反方向，cl(G·f) 本身是因子之一）闭合等价。难点在两处归约与 Gelfand 对应的方向使用。原文位置全在证明的 462 行。
